description: Mineral patches (Mg, P, K, Zn, Se) for foods where the primary source omits these. Applied to reseed preview. Every value has a cited source or proxy.

sources.venison_proxy: USDA FDC 167622 (Deer, venison, sitka, raw) does not report Mg, P, K, Zn, Se. Values from lean game meat / raw beef round proxy: Mg 21, P 201, K 330, Zn 4, Se 10 µg/100g (nutritionvalue.org raw venison; USDA SR Legacy beef round similar).
sources.nori_literature: Nori dried: Mg 250 mg, P 225 mg, K 2550 mg, Zn 3.5 mg (mid-range of Vita Library 200–300 Mg, 150–300 P, 2300–2800 K, 2–5 Zn; https://vitalibrary.com/nori-nutrition-benefits-risks/). Se not reported; use 0.
sources.dulse_literature: Dulse: Mg 350 mg, P 80 mg (estimate), K 1600 mg (dulsevita.com 8g serving 16% RNI → ~1600 mg/100g). Zn/Se from seaweedproducts.ie low; Zn 0.5 mg, Se 0.
sources.chlorella_literature: Chlorella powder (dry): Mg 500 mg, P 1100 mg, K 1550 mg, Zn 4.6 mg (mid-range Frontiers 2020: Mg 0.3–0.7%, P 0.7–1.5%, K 0.7–2.4%, Zn 28–64 mg/kg). Se trace (0). PMC7557355, variability in commercial products.
